sc_cortisol_pro.name: Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro
sc_cortisol_pro.key: Per 2 capsules: 300 mg maral root, 250 mg Relora bark, 250 mg rhodiola, 150 mg ashwagandha, 100 mg L-theanine, 100 mg phosphatidylserine
sc_cortisol_pro.src: Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro sell sheet ND975 Rev. 2/25 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro SS ND975.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAwfzw, read into scratchpad labels/labels.json): per 2 capsules maral root extract (Rhaponticum carthamoides) 300 mg, Relora (Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense bark extracts) 250 mg, Rhodiola rosea root powder 250 mg, ashwagandha root and leaf extract (Sensoril, 10% withanolides) 150 mg, L-theanine (Suntheanine) 100 mg, phosphatidylserine (from sunflower) 100 mg; 30 servings; directions 'Take two capsules daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner'; caution 'Do not use if pregnant. If nursing or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' Same phosphatidylserine, Sensoril, L-theanine and Relora amounts in products DB R2182 (Integrative Therapeutics and Nutri-West switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26). Size: ND144 price list 10/1/26 (R2182 60C). Timing: the label gives no time of day. The sheet puts both capsules at breakfast (it used to split them breakfast and dinner) because the formula's rhodiola (250 mg) and maral root are commonly taken early in the day, since some people find them stimulating, and this sheet is for people who are already wired at night. URL: nutridyn.com/cortisol-pro is in a web-search index of nutridyn.com (2026-11-03, with the R2182 product page and the ND975 sell sheet); nutridyn.com itself is blocked from this sandbox, so the link was not opened. Open it before publishing. Name line: 'Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro', the name on NutriDyn's ND144 price list 10/1/26 ('Stress Essentials Cortisol Pro R2182 60C'), so the four Stress Essentials products on this sheet all carry the line name on the name line (the size line is the count only); a no-break space keeps 'Cortisol Pro' together, so the name wraps after 'Essentials' on the bottle line and in the daily rhythm. 'Relora bark': Relora is a blend of two bark extracts (Magnolia officinalis and Phellodendron amurense, ND975), so the label line says 'bark' after the trade name; a longer gloss would push the line to seven lines and out of level with the other columns.

sc_balance.name: Stress Essentials Balance
sc_balance.key: Per 3 capsules: 800 mg cordyceps, 400 mg ashwagandha (Sensoril), 107 mg Asian ginseng extract, 100 mg rhodiola, 58 mg ginseng root
sc_balance.src: Stress Essentials Balance sell sheet ND422 Rev. 8/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Stress Essentials Balance SS ND422.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAlHMA, opened 2026-11-03), Supplement Facts per 3 capsules in label order: Cordyceps extract (fruiting body; Cordyceps militaris) 800 mg, ashwagandha extract (leaf and root; Sensoril) 400 mg, Asian ginseng extract (leaf and root; Panax ginseng; 14% ginsenosides) 107 mg, Rhodiola rosea extract (root; 1 mg salidroside, 3 mg rosavins) 100 mg, Asian ginseng powder (root) 58 mg; servings per container 30/60; directions 'Take three capsules two times daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner'; warning 'Do not use if pregnant or nursing'; caution 'If taking heart medications or have a chronic health condition, inform your healthcare practitioner.' The same five amounts and directions appear in all 11 label reads in products DB R123 (switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26). An earlier version of this entry left rhodiola off because of a nutridyn.com variant seen only through web search; the sell sheet and every DB read list it, so it is printed. Sizes R123 90C and R123L 180C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). DOSE: the sheet prints 3 capsules once daily, HALF the label dose, and says so on the dose bar ('half the label dose'), so ashwagandha (Sensoril) from this plus Cortisol Pro stays at 550 mg a day (400 + 150). At the label dose it would be 950 mg a day (800 + 150), above the 125-500 mg a day used in Sensoril's stress trials and the 300-600 mg a day range in Akhgarjand 2022 (PMID 36017529). NutriDyn's own practitioner dosing chart (Stress Essentials Formulas reference chart V3, 10/2024, Dropbox Product Reference Charts, opened 2026-11-03) gives Balance as 3 capsules once or twice daily with food, depending on the stress level, so 3 capsules once a day is NutriDyn's lower dose, not an off-label one; the bottle's 'three capsules two times daily' is the upper. Asher's sign-off on the lower dose is still requested. Name: 'Stress Essentials Balance' in full on the name line (NutriDyn also sells Estro, Testro, Neuro and Hormone Balance), so the daily-rhythm panel can't be misread. URL: nutridyn.com/stress-management/stress-essentials-balance-seb is in a web-search index of nutridyn.com (2026-11-03; that page lists cordyceps, ashwagandha, Asian ginseng and rhodiola and 'three capsules twice daily'); nutridyn.com is blocked here, so the link was not opened. Open it before publishing.

sc_adrenal_renew.name: Stress Essentials Adrenal Renew
sc_adrenal_renew.key: Per 2 capsules: 300 mg vitamin C, 50 mg B1, 15 mg B2, 60 mg B6, 50 mg B5, 15 mg zinc, 300 mg cow adrenal, 200 mg holy basil, 100 mg L-tyrosine, 50 mg cow spleen
sc_adrenal_renew.src: Stress Essentials Adrenal Renew sell sheet ND788 Rev. 10/24 (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/Stress Essentials Adrenal Renew SS ND788.pdf, id:xHepYs_Ou4AAAAAAAAdpPg, opened 2026-11-03), Supplement Facts per 2 capsules in label order: vitamin C (ascorbic acid) 300 mg (333% DV), thiamine (B1, thiamine HCl) 50 mg (4,167%), riboflavin (B2) 15 mg (1,154%), vitamin B6 (pyridoxine HCl) 60 mg (3,529%), pantothenic acid (B5, d-calcium pantothenate) 50 mg (1,000%), zinc (citrate) 15 mg (136%), suprarenal adrenal substance (bovine) 300 mg, holy basil powder (leaf; Ocimum sanctum) 200 mg, L-tyrosine 100 mg, spleen substance (bovine) 50 mg; capsule is gelatin; 30 servings; directions 'Take two capsules daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner'; caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use.' The seven amounts in products DB R159 (Ortho Molecular Adren-All, Apex Adreno-Zyme and Standard Process chart reads, catalog ND143 10/1/26) match; the DB reads leave out thiamine, riboflavin and holy basil, which the sell sheet lists, so the sheet now prints all ten. 'Bovine' is printed as 'cow'; thiamine prints as 'B1' beside B2, B6 and B5 (the bullet above says 'B vitamins'), which keeps the label line to six lines so the column is no taller than its neighbours. Size 60C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Column framing: the switch charts list it as the close match to Ortho Molecular Adren-All, and the topic research found its real use is stepping patients down from a glandular (Asher, 2026-10-05: 'step the glandular down... bridge with a botanical HPA'), so the column is 'Coming off a glandular?' / 'only if you already take one', its first bullet says it REPLACES the glandular the patient already takes ('Replaces your current glandular (dried cow adrenal)'; the medicine check adds 'never with another'), so nobody takes it on top of another brand's glandular, and the dose bar reads '2 capsules at breakfast' / 'then step down as directed'. Two capsules is the label dose ('Take two capsules daily'); breakfast follows NutriDyn's Stress Essentials Formulas chart V3 (ND_CHART_Stress Essentials_V3.pdf, Dropbox Product Reference Charts, 10/2024, reopened 2026-11-03: Adrenal Renew dosage 2 capsules, frequency once or twice daily, with food yes, preferred time 'Earlier in the day'); the step-down is the use the column is for. Name line: 'Stress Essentials Adrenal Renew', the name on the ND144 price list 10/1/26 ('Stress Essentials Adrenal Renew R159 60C'), like the other Stress Essentials products on the sheet; a no-break space keeps 'Adrenal Renew' together. It is NOT in the daily rhythm (sched is empty here and in the sheet's column), so the plan's total is 7 pills and 1 scoop: a glandular is nobody's first step (Akturk HK, Mayo Clin Proc 2018, PMID 29502560: unlabelled thyroid and steroid hormones in all 12 adrenal-support supplements tested), and its 60 mg vitamin B6 would take everyone's plan to 65 mg a day (EFSA upper limit 12 mg, EFSA J 2023, PMID 37207271; US 100 mg). The medicine check makes the 65 mg conditional ('With Adrenal Renew, B6 reaches 65 mg'). URL: nutridyn.com/stress-essentials-adrenal-renew-r159 is in a web-search index of nutridyn.com (2026-11-03); nutridyn.com is blocked here, so the link was not opened. Open it before publishing.
